additional_info.subject: ID0465760-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RD 170003085] SCB states multiple Error Flags CRM:02888000480
additional_info.body:
Hi Konrad, good morning.
Sorry for the delay.
The error that you are seeing is related to the Modbus communication failing in the IMDs.
Please check the modbus circuit, I would start from this connector as it seems that it works sometimes:
Remove the connector from each other and reconnect.
If it doesn't work, please check all the connections to the Pump:
And both IMDs:
If nothing else works, please replace the KF11.
I will send this to the RC-PL queue, if you need any support reach out to me via Teams directly.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
